profile: non-negative matrix factorization: a matrix factorization problem in which a matrix X is approximated as the product C W, with both C and W constrained to be non-negative. The objective is to minimize the squared Frobenius norm of the residual, ||C W - X||_F^2, subject to C ≥ 0 and W ≥ 0.
